name: NYPlug New York Power Group
description: Entrance and exit to a building. At the rear, there is a spawn point and an additional entrance. The building has multiple stories.

name: Stone 6 (Saul & Co)
description: A three-story office building. Access to the third-floor office requires a key.

name: Activity-Full Sphere Solutions
description: A multi-story office building. The penultimate floor contains a safe that can be opened with a key. Two staircases provide access to this floor: the staircase closest to the front of the building, which faces southwest, continues to the top of the building, while the other terminates at the penultimate floor.

images.description: the safe on the second to last floor (1)
another entrance located at the side of the building

name: Apartment Building Near NYPlug
description: A four-story apartment building connected to NYPlug. Following the hallways on the first floor, as shown on the map, will lead to NYPlug. Be aware that players may spawn on the upper floors. During the night, a medium to large number of zombies may also spawn here.

images.description: First Floor Entrance and Hallway Entrance

name: Extraction Point Whitehall
description: An extraction point. An enemy outpost, where two enemies may spawn, is located at the ladder leading to the extraction point.

images.description: extraction point on top of the ladder (Photographer:Nintendoboi2)

name: Extraction Point Pier
description: An extraction point located on the rooftop of this building. Use the escalators to reach the top. In PvP, players often camp or loot this area, so proceed with caution.

name: Booth Pier 13
description: A small booth, can be entered.

name: Cobble Fish
description: A small building. Cannot be entered. Probably used for storage

name: Pier 17
description: A medium to large multi story building that appears to be a former shopping center. On the northeast side, directly next to the building, there is a medium sized enemy outpost. The top floor can be reached using the escalators and has an extraction point on the roof.

name: Pier Enemy Outpost
description: An enemy outpost near Pier 17.

name: Tin Building Market Flood Hall
description: TBA

name: Damage Bridge1
description: This area of the bridge is damaged.

name: Damaged Bridge2

name: Water Treatment Plant (Site C)
description: The Water Treatment Plant, also known as Site C, located under the bridge, has the most aggressive zombie spawns and the highest population. Raiding this location is strongly recommended with multiple team members, as solo runs are nearly impossible. The area includes an underground sewer system where spawns are at their worst, with zombies sometimes appearing right in front of you. Common strategies include shooting zombies in the legs to immobilize them and prevent respawns, or having one teammate lure them out while another moves in.

name: Metro New York Hospital
description: A massive explorable building with multiple floors, a rooftop extraction point, and an overwhelming number of zombies. Make sure you’re fully prepared before heading in.

name: Extraction point hospital
description: The exact conditions for using this extraction point are unclear for me, but it appears to be used by a helicopter when extracting from the hospital quarantine zone via the CSEL extraction radio. The helicopter lands on the highest accessible floor of the helicopter landing pad.

name: Crashed Helicopter
description: A crashed helicopter right next to the hospital building.

name: Saul Mart
description: TBA

name: Southbridge Towers
description: Two towers of varying height that can be used to access the hospital quarantine zone.

name: Euro Deli
description: A small, multi-story building that is excellent for scouting. It provides an almost complete view of the entire bridge, with the top floor offering a near 360-degree view.

name: Extraction Point South
description: It can be accessed via the southeast or northwest staircases.

name: Stone 16
description: This is an apartment building with a diner on the ground floor. The first floor has a hallway that connects the stairs, kitchen, and restaurant. The second floor contains an apartment that can be accessed using the 16 Stone Key. The apartment usually contains ammo, weapons, and food or water supplies. It consists of a kitchen, a small living area, and a bedroom. The building also has a third floor.

inside the second floor apartment room

name: Triple R Diner Camp
description: An enemy camp. For more info about the building see the Stone 16 location pin.

name: Liberty Bank
description: A bank. At the back, there is a reinforced glass door that cannot be broken. Mounted on the wall beside it is a keycard reader. Insert the keycard to unlock the door and access the vault. More info TBA

name: Stone 8
description: An apartment building that appears to have belonged to a former militant. Upon entering the second-floor apartment, the best loot is immediately to the right. It usually contains gas masks, camouflage gear, and ammunition. More info TBA

images.description: The apartment you need a key for

name: Safe at Activity-Full
description: A safe located on the second to last floor of the Activity Full Sphere Solutions Office. When taking the first stairs, go left on the second to last floor. It should be on that side of the building.

name: Westbridge Partners Office
description: A large office building with two staircases leading up to the offices: one at the front-left (southwest) and one on the left side (northwest). Typically, 3–5 zombies spawn here, though the spawning can be quite aggressive. Zombies can appear on the opposite side of the building, so even if you’re standing on one side, they may spawn behind you.

name: 05 Key
description:
An office room accessible with the 05 key. Inside, you can frequently find 7.62 and 5.56 ammunition, weapons, as well as clothing and gas masks. Occasionally, other keys may also spawn here.

On the right side, near the windows, there is another enterable building directly across from this one. Proceed with caution.

name: Quill
description: A clothing store, can be used to access the maintance gate.

name: Spawnpoint Near NYPlug
description: The spawn point is in the building next to NYPlug. Players can spawn on one of the upper floors, usually inside a room.

name: S William spawnpoint
description: Spawnpoint, pretty close to a extraction point.

name: Enemy Outpost near whitehall extraction
description: An enemy outpost pretty much guarding the extraction point. Though only 2 basic enemies spawn here, but they can gain the attention of nearby zombies that can come out of the Quill clothing store.

name: Office key
description: A key used to access the third-floor office in Stone 6. This office often contains large ammunition boxes, 5.56 weapons, and food and water supplies.

name: Zombie Nest Ground Zero 2 Garage
description: An underground garage system. The top level contains an improvised meeting room, accessible with a key. Below are two garage floors packed with cars and tight spaces. Clear out most zombies in the larger open areas as you move down to avoid getting ambushed while looting. Stealth isn’t an option here unless zombie numbers are low.

name: Ground Zero 2 Quarantine Zone
description: A quarantine zone with an underground garage. The top level of the garage contains an improvised meeting room, accessible with a key. Below it are two more levels packed with cars, tight corners, and plenty of zombies.

name: Improvised Meeting Room
description: The improvised meeting room is located on the top floor of the Ground Zero 2 garage. When heading there, it’s best to use the west entrance and go straight to the garage. Silently take out the zombies in front and loot the room without being spotted, or you’ll aggro the horde below. The room usually contains ammo and medical supplies.

images.description: Western entrance point of the garage

name: Federal Reserve Bank of New York
description: TBA

name: Quill Jewerly
description: Has already been ransacked however a locked room is in the back. Can only be accessed through the windows. (written by Nintendoboi2)

name: Ground Zero Bandit Camp
description:
Small bandit camp, they hold down a gate that leads into ground zero. Gate requires a key. Has 3 bandits, one of them roams into the parking lot across.

Stash Spot for the distraction device in Wetwork, pt. 4
  (written by Nintendoboi2)

name: Gate
description: The gate that leads into Ground Zero Quarantine zone. Protected by 3 bandits. Can be opened using a key.

name: Armory
description: Here you can use the armory key, located at the lowest floor.

name: Zombie Nest
description: This zombie nest is located in and beneath a garage. Large numbers of zombies spawn here, so it’s best to enter during the day. The area can be accessed from the southeast and the northwest.

name: Quarantine Zone Military Checkpoint
description: A quarantine zone that includes a military checkpoint. Many militant zombies spawn here. There is also an underground system which seems to be a garage next to it where the armory is located on the lowest floor. An M249 usually spawns next to it there, along with other valuable items. More info TBA

images.description: The back entrance, which is the recommended entry point, located right next to the basketball field.

name: Cities service buildings
description: This hotel has a jewelry store, 2 cafes, and a clothing store. The jewelry store wasn't fully ransacked and some loot can be found inside. The two stairs on the right side are buggy and allow the player to somewhat "clip" inside of them when crouched. (written by nintendoboi2)

name: 646 Broadway
description: A fairly large apartment building. On the second-to-last floor, there is a long hallway that leads to another set of stairs outside the building. Using these stairs, you can reach the top floor if you have the key. Be cautious, as there is a zombie nest right next to it. Zombies may spawn in large numbers outside the nest and can spot you from the stairs.

images.description: The hallway on the second to last floor.

name: Emergency Exit 646 Broadway
description: Here you can use the key for the emergency exit at the top floor of 646 broadway. Can only be accessed using the outside stairs.

name: Ground Zero Quarantine Zone
description:
The largest quarantine zone, Ground Zero. It contains the biggest explorable building, Metro New York Hospital. 
The zone can be accessed from the southeast via the Southbridge Towers, from the northwest through a key-required gate, or from the southeast using the subway station at the intersection of Pine and Water Street.

name: Pine Apartment Complex
description:
Has 4ish zombies. An exit leading NW onto William and SE onto Broad. A bandit camp is outside on the NW side along with a survivor spawn and infiltration point. Has 5 floors with rooftop access and a emergency fire exit on the NW side. On the NE side is a police checkpoint with a SWAT van.
 (Written by Nintendoboi2)

name: Lucia & Proxy's Midnight Cafe Safehouse
description: Small Cafe located on William. Has no zombies and a small back room. (written by nintendoboi2)

name: Watson and Stone Hotel Safehouse
description: A hotel located on Wall and Broad. Has a few zombies inside. Has 3 floors with zombies on every level. Strangely the TV's are on in all rooms. The second and third floors only have one room each. (written by nintendoboi2)
